crossRefs.note: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of…
Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.
Aaron spoke all the words which Yahweh had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which Yahweh commanded him.
translations.bsb: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all these words that the LORD had commanded him.
translations.kjv: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded
translations.asv: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which Jehovah commanded him.
